name: Text Sparks
description: Canvas effect that forms large letters out of glowing, twinkling particles with sparks drifting off them, fading in and out in per-letter colors on a dark background.
contents: Full-viewport canvas rendering colored letters made of particles
behavior: Letters are sampled into points that pulse and twinkle with additive blending
Sparks spawn from the letter points and fade as they drift
Text fades in, holds for the display time, then fades out and repeats

props.name: textItems
props.default: D, E, V, I, L letters with blue, red and amber hues

editableByProps: Letters and the color of each letter

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the font used to draw the letters

fixed: Canvas is sized from the window dimensions, so the component is meant to fill the viewport
Letter mask is built once and is not rebuilt on resize
